method: Rolling-origin model comparison with final holdout
interpretation: LightGBM had the lowest mean validation MAE (0.825); the runner-up was Combination(top3) (0.862). Final-holdout MAE for the selection: 1.21 against 1.21 for Seasonal naive. Validation MAE of Seasonal naive: 1.1.
assumptions: Regular series with the declared season and no missing periods
The training history's pattern continues over the horizon (no regime change)
Specifications are frozen on the first training slice, so later actuals cannot steer selection
not_done: No regressors, promotions or calendar effects (pool regressors, chapter 13 or 16 add them)
Conformal bands pool the origin and holdout residuals of the selected model; chapter 17 calibrates on a longer window

route_reasons: a regular series with enough history: the chapter 12 engine (smoothing, ARIMA, Theta, STL, LightGBM, combinations) at rolling origins
warnings: 1 outlying observations by STL residuals (period 12), two passes; check them, do not delete them
possible level shift 146 periods before the end (from 23.09 to 23.12)

conformal: conformal_lower/upper are split-conformal bands at nominal 80% from LightGBM's absolute residuals at the 5 selection origins plus its 12 final-holdout residuals (the holdout was never used for selection), 72 residuals pooled and scaled per step, rank level raised to 0.847 for the finite sample; the origin-only band covered 67% of the holdout. If future absolute errors are exchangeable with these residuals the band covers at least 80% on average across steps; the guarantee is marginal, not per step, and a level shift or a change in error size voids it.
evaluation: 5 expanding origins spaced 12 steps apart select the model on mean MAE; the final 12 observations are scored once and never used for selection; the selection is refitted on all history. A model that loses to Seasonal naive at more than half the origins cannot be selected.
intervals: LightGBM produces no model intervals; empirical_q* columns are signed residual quantiles by horizon step from the 5 selection origins (5 residuals per step) and are descriptive.
